admission.justification: A test calls render on a malformed mixed launch and requires the unknown-tool answer instead of a seat refusal.

applicability: Calls to explainer tools on a process that holds an explainer binding.
conditions: The called name is one of the explainer's four tools.
exclusions: AR's general tools, which answer the seat as they answer any agent.
statement: The pre-dispatch explainer seat guard applies only to explainer tools the process still retains, so a pruned explainer tool takes the ordinary unknown-tool path instead of answering a seat refusal.
